name: Zodiac Series - Gem encrusted Pig (CSGFT100)
description:
The warm-hearted Zodiac Pig ushers in the new Lunar Year 2019! To welcome and celebrate this festive season, a series of limited edition philatelic collectibles are available exclusively at SingPost.


Add a touch of sparkle to your living or work places, with this intricate gem-encrusted art piece to bring in good fortune for the year 2019.
